replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
[Denied] I'm sorry to say your map has been denied and will not be featured on the Avicus Network on the repository.
Your Map was denied for the following reasons
-Too Small - Rushing looks far too easy, seeing as the monuments don't have much of a distance between eachother. There isn't much pvp space and spawn camping would be a major problem.
-Not Aesthetically pleasing. The map lacks something that stands out about it, and the block variants don't seem to flow well.
